note: Lawrence County PA publishes zoning only as PDF maps: county planning page lists municipal zoning maps for about 9-18 boroughs and townships as PDFs; New Castle city zoning map is a PDF with no GIS layer found; Ellwood City map is also a PDF. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for Lawrence County, PA zoning returned no queryable zoning district service (only Clearfield County's Planning Viewer, a different county). Parcel data with zoning is commercial only (Regrid, Dynamo, Rockford).
